name: Python simple index
auth: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission.
fresh_home: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.
prerequisites: A built wheel or sdist under dist/.
Use the pinned Python client image, where Poetry has its own tool virtual environment.
Python 3 is required by the configuration snippet to encode runtime credentials safely.

configure.code:
export AW_AUTH_URL="$(python3 - <<'PYCODE'
import os
from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit, urlunsplit
u = urlsplit(os.environ['AW_URL'])
auth = quote(os.environ['AW_USER'], safe='') + ':' + quote(os.environ['AW_TOKEN'], safe='')
print(urlunsplit((u.scheme, auth + '@' + u.netloc, u.path, '', '')))
PYCODE
)"
configure.note: Requires Python 3 only to URL-encode runtime credentials. AW_AUTH_URL contains a secret: disable shell tracing, do not echo it, and use a disposable private configuration directory.

configure.code:
export PIP_CACHE_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
export PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$PIP_CACHE_DIR/uv"
export POETRY_CACHE_DIR="$PIP_CACHE_DIR/poetry"
export AW_PYPI_INDEX="$AW_AUTH_URL/artifactory/api/pypi/$AW_REPO/simple/"

publish.note: Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

steps.note: The upload endpoint differs from /simple/. Keep secrets out of captured command output.

install.note: Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

steps.code:
python -m venv --without-pip consumer-env
uv pip install --python consumer-env/bin/python --no-deps --no-cache --index-url "$AW_PYPI_INDEX" acme-smoke==1.0.0
steps.note: Replace example coordinates with the package published above; use a new virtual environment and no public extra-index fallback.

limitations: Poetry and Twine have additional tested flows in the linked acceptance files; this minimal recipe uses uv.
Replacing a stored version with different bytes requires delete permission as well as write permission.

The catalog also registers virtual/federated classes, but this recipe only advertises classes with matching native-client evidence. Registered configuration support alone is not a native recipe qualification; remaining virtual/federated proof belongs to the follow-on phase.

contains: uv and Poetry publish and install through the negotiated simple index
A Basic user name must name the token's subject
pip and uv install from cold and offline remote repositories
